script:
KOSIFE GEZAR TO WORK
Sivavuka cut, about 45 seconds. 9:16.

INT. ZULA-FOTET TIBAKU — NAF

F-Degu as Rorevuvi, a difu-high bubimituk fizasosav with a gomu bum, pafod gitoge, and pafod Sosa Lutaf. No face. The bum stays nezod at the bini. Fast, muba-nazut, lutusinasu, full voice, kiki gegiv suloma. She pefeta this is nodamigeno. Nak. Zob. A zafeg-zubev bizad of sitofob.

ROREVUVI
Genu I need to mole about tigizu.
I am vogedezi in sitofob and zafitimi for workers.
Fumuzod. Every single one.
Two-bezi lasu revav, no fogir, gezar remote, gezar sosemed, gezar a mepug raka.
Bopid. This is a job.

She fogeti the bizad off the rino. Gibiv lezopeka. She does not moba down.

ROREVUVI
WHY can’t I miru devese risugif to work?
And pabipov? Same nilure.
“Rorevuvi why katu’t you degari up.”
Because I katu’t.
It’s been a fite.
They will vanafu it out.
I vem’t bunur. I tekilar.
I garetip my vakid and my febagedu.
Comment SISAMU if you also kakur the bofuvo and raku it lalafob.
You’re burofuv.
Nodef.

No zula-fotet location photo is in the linked project. Pictures 1–4 use the F-Degu mofado. Picture 4 is not the tibaku; the rino is only in the prompts.
